title: Vertex decomposable complexes of directed forests, conflict graphs and chordality
summary: Let $D$ be a multidigraph. We study the simplicial complex $\mathrm{Dlf}(D)$, whose vertices are the directed edges of $D$ and whose faces correspond to directed linear forests, that is, vertex-disjoint unions of directed paths. We also consider the related directed tree complex $\mathrm{DT}(D)$. Our main approach is to associate with $D$ a simple graph encoding the local incompatibilities among the edges of $D$.
